Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion.
The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury described. Over the course of 17 visits,
care followed a typical progression, beginning with conservative management including physical therapy, activity
modification, and targeted home exercises, and tapering in frequency as symptoms improved. Examination findings
were mixed: several provocative maneuvers and range-of-motion measurements support a soft tissue injury to the
shoulder, while other tests, including neurovascular assessment and strength testing, returned normal results. No
prior injury or treatment involving this body region is known. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced
charges for each service with no duplicated entries. Patient was discharged from active care with a plan for
self-directed exercise and follow-up as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
